_comment: Pinned on purpose: a system driver (xess-xmx-linux) and a Decky plugin (Decky Framegen) are installed only at a tested tag; 'pending-verification' asks before installing the latest. tools/upstream_watch.py reports newer ones.

xess_xmx_linux.note: 20261104: low latency with XeSS frame generation on by default (IGDEXT_XELL_CAP), FSR 3.1+ games on XeSS (FSR=xess), XESS_FG up to 8x

decky_framegen.note: v0.17 (OptiScaler 0.9.4, FSR 4 variants) installed and opened on the Claw 8 EX 2026-11-04. OptiScaler per game (Bazzite ships it in the Portal); ClawDeck installs it only where it is missing, and passes Intel presets to it through its environment variables

reframework.note: Capcom RE Engine games: dinput8.dll next to the game's exe (one zip for every game). Pinned after the Onimusha test on a Claw.
